topic.title: Topic Names
topic.description: Comma separated list of Kafka topic names

bootstrapServers.title: Bootstrap Servers
bootstrapServers.description: Comma separated list of Kafka Broker URLs

autoCommitEnable.title: Auto Commit Enable
autoCommitEnable.description: If true, periodically commit to ZooKeeper the offset of messages already fetched by the consumer

allowManualCommit.title: Allow Manual Commit
allowManualCommit.description: Whether to allow doing manual commits

pollOnError.title: Poll On Error Behavior
pollOnError.description: What to do if kafka threw an exception while polling for new messages. There are 5 enums and the value can be one of `DISCARD`, `ERROR_HANDLER`, `RECONNECT`, `RETRY`, `STOP`

autoOffsetReset.title: Auto Offset Reset
autoOffsetReset.description: What to do when there is no initial offset. There are 3 enums and the value can be one of latest, earliest, none

consumerGroup.title: Consumer Group
consumerGroup.description: A string that uniquely identifies the group of consumers to which this source belongs

deserializeHeaders.title: Automatically Deserialize Headers
deserializeHeaders.description: When enabled the Kamelet source will deserialize all message headers to String representation.

valueDeserializer.title: Value Deserializer
valueDeserializer.description: Deserializer class for value that implements the Deserializer interface.

avroDatumProvider.title: Avro Datum Provider
avroDatumProvider.description: How to read data with Avro

batchSize.title: Batch Dimension
batchSize.description: The maximum number of records returned in a single call to poll()

pollTimeout.title: Poll Timeout Interval
pollTimeout.description: The timeout used when polling the KafkaConsumer

maxPollIntervalMs.title: Max Poll Interval
maxPollIntervalMs.description: The maximum delay between invocations of poll() when using consumer group management

batchingIntervalMs.title: Batching Interval
batchingIntervalMs.description: In consumer batching mode, then this option is specifying a time in millis, to trigger batch completion eager when the current batch size has not reached the maximum size defined by maxPollRecords. Notice the trigger is not exact at the given interval, as this can only happen between kafka polls (see pollTimeoutMs option).

apicurioAuthServiceUrl.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Service URL
apicurioAuthServiceUrl.description: The URL for Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

apicurioAuthRealm.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Realm
apicurioAuthRealm.description: The Realm in Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

apicurioAuthClientId.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Client ID
apicurioAuthClientId.description: The Client ID in Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

apicurioAuthClientSecret.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Client Secret
apicurioAuthClientSecret.description: The Client Secret in Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

apicurioAuthUsername.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Username
apicurioAuthUsername.description: The Username in Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

apicurioAuthPassword.title: Apicurio Registry Auth Password
apicurioAuthPassword.description: The Password in Keycloak instance securing the Apicurio Registry

topicIsPattern.title: Topic Is Pattern
topicIsPattern.description: Whether the topic is a pattern (regular expression). This can be used to subscribe to dynamic number of topics matching the pattern.
